versions.changelog: Remove --standby flag (endpoints are server-answered by default now); document --email inboxes.

Full current webhook feature set: signature verification (--verify, 16 provider presets), server-side forwarding with transforms (--forward/--match), email/push notifications, cloud history (requests), ttl never. Corrected pricing/TTL claims to match the live pricing API.
Flagship recipe: wake your Claw from public webhooks with zero gateway exposure (capture endpoint + --deliver-exec relay to loopback /hooks/wake). Adds await and local-delivery commands.

Initial release: instant tunnels and capture/replay webhook endpoints for OpenClaw - public HTTPS URLs for /hooks/wake and /hooks/agent, stable subdomains, standby capture, credit-metered pricing with a $3/30d cap per endpoint.
